turns.assessment: The failure is localized to the 81.3 km cable segment represented by E8 in the S12→S15 direction and E19 in the reverse direction. OSC loss occurs on both paired fibres, while the upstream amplifiers retain power and the next amplifiers lose input, which is the signature of a break between those sites. The simultaneous all-channel, bidirectional loss strongly favors a physical fibre cut over amplifier, ROADM, or channel-specific faults.

proposals.rationale: O25 reports OSC loss on E8, and E4 plus all downstream S12→S15 equipment lose input. The reverse-direction OSC loss on E19 is on the corresponding 81.3 km paired fibre, indicating that both fibres of the same cable segment were cut simultaneously.
An exceptionally large abrupt loss on this span could suppress both payload and OSC, but simultaneous complete loss on both paired directional fibres is much more characteristic of a cut.
